contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"carry","text":"Had Marchetti carried the ball forward instead of shooting, the chance to score would have been substantially higher (12.1% vs 4.5%), so carrying was the better decision."},{"experiment_id":"pass_H16","text":"Had Marchetti passed to Sami Okoro (CM), the chance to score would have increased (9.2% vs 4.5%), making that pass a clearly better option than the shot."}]}
